equipment_type: Split air conditioner BACnet IP gateway (legacy)
applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric Mr. SLIM (A-control) split air conditioners, up to 50 outdoor units each fitted with a Sub I/F board.
summary: The Procon BAC-A/50 is an older Mitsubishi Electric UK gateway that links up to 50 Mr. SLIM systems (through Sub I/F boards daisy-chained to its TB12 terminals) to BACnet IP. Each unit address gets the same block of 14 objects (setup _w, state _r, error code and room temperature) named after the unit name typed into the configuration program, plus four system objects. It is the Mr. SLIM sibling of the Procon BAC-IP/50 (CITY MULTI via G-50) and has a smaller object set.
notes: Per-unit instance = 1UUUPP: UUU = unit address 001-050, PP = point 01-14. Instances here use unit 001 (e.g. 100101). Object names start with the unit name (nnn) set in the configuration program.
Points 1xxx15-1xxx22 are listed as unused and are not included.
The manual has no access column: commandable/writable access is inferred from the object types and Setup/State labels.
Setpoint ranges depend on mode: cool/dry 19-30 °C, heat 17-28 °C, auto 19-28 °C; in other modes the setpoint is fixed at 25 °C.
Segmentation is not supported and the maximum APDU is 206 octets.

integration.summary: Wire the Sub I/F boards to TB12, set IP, Device ID and unit names with the PC configuration program, then map each unit's _w (command) and _r (status) objects at 1UUUPP. BV 100024 switches every unit off at once.

minimum_points.why: Fan speed: 1 low, 2 mid2, 3 mid1, 4 high
minimum_points.name: nnn_FS_w

integration.enable: The Enable Link terminals take a normally-closed volt-free contact (shipped with a wire link). Opening it sends Forced-Off to all units every 5 s; closing it sends one Reset, so later BMS Forced-Off commands (BV 100024) are not overridden.
setup: Level-2 reset defaults: IP 192.168.1.14, mask 255.255.255.0, BACnet Device ID 14, device name Procon BAC-A/50, units to scan 50.
Device ID, device name and object names are set only through the PC configuration program (RS232).
Set Sys_Units_To_Scan (AV 100023) to the number of units to shorten the start-up scan; it takes effect after a restart.
gotchas: If the BMS writes commands continuously, set BV 100026 active so the gateway only sends changed values.
The gateway polls one unit every 2 s, so on a 50-unit system each unit is refreshed only about every 100 s.

points.name: Sys_Units_To_Scan
points.description: Number of units scanned, 1-50 (applies after restart)

points.name: Sys_New_Setting_Compare
points.states: Inactive=Always write, Active=Write only if different
